v03-verify.description: Verify one reviewed ledgerwash spec 3 commit on the EC Windows pool. Create an isolated job-local venv and install only the six pure-Python pytest dependencies pinned with wheel hashes in the committed uv.lock (PyPI downloads; no cache). Run all tests including A1-A9 and stabilization regressions; require nonzero tests, zero failures/errors/skips. Run qualify and compare full raw scan JSON from independent processes at PYTHONHASHSEED 1 and 17 on the same pinned planted corpus, expecting exit 1 and all 14 rules. Preserve exact source SHA, runtime, dependency locks, commands, exits, logs, JUnit and JSON hashes. Do not execute scanned subject code, call models, publish packages, change the spec, or access credentials.

phase.description: baseline before changes; coverage includes strict controls and real-ledger triage

current_sha.description: Current EC epoch pinned before workload integration

redteam-verify.description: Replay all 21 preserved red-team cases against the frozen PR2 judge dc133028fb7405ed61c315ea3efbee26f134d015 and the exact candidate; use isolated hash-pinned pytest dependencies, all tests and qualify, independent-process byte replay, full raw logs, fixture and judge SHAs. Scope also covers later verification-coverage spec changes, paired positive/negative controls, and readonly scans of fixed historical/current EC Git corpus inputs with before/after triage. Never execute subject code, access credentials, call models, publish packages or deploy. Network downloads only hash-pinned pytest wheels; corpus inputs are offline and pinned. Errors, missing cases, invalid outputs, skips or nondeterminism fail the workload; attacks passing the baseline are recorded as observations, not claimed as caught. Baseline phase replays cases before contract changes; coverage phase additionally reads historical/current EC commits from the full-history GITHUB_WORKSPACE EC checkout, clones only into the job directory, scans readonly without executing subject code, and publishes raw corpus results only to EC private receipt refs. EC source collection uses Actions checkout with persist-credentials false; no token reaches this script.
